title: Parallel classification (cls) vs. autoregressive generation (ar)
question: Holding the prompt and prefix format fixed, how does step-by-step prediction via a learned ParallelClassificationHead (predicting o_k and flag_k in parallel) compare in sample efficiency and accuracy against next-token prediction via the parameter-free SubspaceLMHead? Note on unconverged step_accuracy trajectories: both evaluators stop on a premature halt so post-halt steps receive zero credit, but at a premature halt on step k itself cls still emits (pred_o[k], FLAG_FINISHED) on separate heads whereas emitting [EOS] at step k in ar occupies the symbol slot.
